final: SELECT transref, avg_count, avg_count - overall_avg AS above_overall, avg_count - kept_avg AS above_kept FROM (SELECT per_transaction.*, avg(avg_count) OVER () AS overall_avg, avg(CASE WHEN avg_count > (SELECT avg(anlycount) FROM (SELECT transref, avg(anlycount) AS avg_count FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref)) THEN avg_count END) OVER () AS kept_avg FROM (SELECT transref, avg(anlycount) AS avg_count FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref) AS per_transaction) WHERE avg_count > overall_avg ORDER BY above_kept DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
